payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Using all saved support findings, mark complete only when evidence establishes both a chalk-drawing rendering and whole-image transformation. Mark partial when evidence establishes some genuine chalk-drawing progress but not a complete whole-image transformation. Mark absent only when evidence establishes no requested chalk-drawing progress; unrelated edits alone are absent. Mark unknown when necessary evidence is insufficient or unresolved. Do not treat chalk-like texture or scene-wide coverage alone as proof of a drawing or completion. A failed extent check may indicate incompleteness, not absence, when another finding establishes progress; a negative drawing-rendering finding does not erase separately evidenced progress.
node.binding: Target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.. Reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing..
